def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fg = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    bg = next(v for v in counts if v != fg)
    return [[0 if v == fg else fg if v == bg else v for v in row] for row in grid]
